label: WhatsApp Send Media (Baileys)
description: Send a stored file (image, video, audio, or document) via the project's WhatsApp bridge, with an optional caption. Wire `endpointUrl` from a BaileyBridge and `file` from any node that outputs a file. `voiceNote: true` sends an audio file as a voice note (the playable bubble) instead of an audio attachment.

inputs.name: voiceNote
inputs.label: Send audio as a voice note
inputs.description: For audio only: `true` sends it as a voice note (WhatsApp's playable bubble, the shape a spoken reply takes); `false` sends it as an audio file. Ignored for any other media.
